Our Story

Estilo was built on 15+ years of deep manufacturing expertise in Odisha — home to India's finest textile craftsmen. Long before the online custom apparel market existed, we were running full production lines, delivering bulk orders to corporates, sports brands, and exporters.

Our facility is recognized by the Ministry of Textile, Government of India — housing international-grade stitching machines, in-house sublimation and screen printing setups, and a 50+ person team dedicated to quality. From a 5-piece corporate order to a 50,000-piece bulk shipment, every piece gets the same treatment.

We've served 5000+ companies across every major industry — IT giants, FMCG brands, sports academies, NGOs, hospitals, and government departments. With 5 Lakh+ products delivered and a 98%+ on-time rate, we bring the reliability of an established manufacturer to a seamless online experience.

Today we ship across all of India and to 8+ countries — UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Guinea, Tanzania and South Africa — bringing Indian manufacturing quality to the world at the most competitive prices.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know before placing your order.

What is the minimum order quantity?

Minimum 5 pieces per design. No upper limit — we've handled single orders of 50,000+ pieces for large corporates.

How long does delivery take?

We dispatch within 48–72 hours of order confirmation. Pan India delivery in 2–5 business days depending on your location.

Do you serve companies across all of India?

Yes. We deliver to every pin code in India — from metros to Tier 3 cities. We've served 5000+ companies across 28 states.

Can you print our company logo on the products?

Absolutely. We offer screen printing, DTF printing, sublimation, and embroidery. Your logo goes exactly where you want — chest, back, sleeves.

What types of products do you customize?

T-shirts, polo shirts, hoodies, jackets, caps, aprons, tote bags, and more. All customizable with your branding.

Is partial payment (COD) available?

Yes. We offer Partial COD — pay an advance to confirm, balance on delivery. This is unique to Estilo and very popular with corporates.
